doc.title: Maria Schneider interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001

title: Opening and the Jazz Educators conference
summary: Monk Rowe opens the interview and they chat about the busy conference week.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m quite pleased to have Maria Schneider with me this afternoon. And I know you have been working both ends of your life — quite busy the last few days.

Yeah, with the performance of my orchestra, and panels, and then just seeing everybody that you ever met in school or working overseas or in the States and from schools and things. So it’s pretty crazy here.
This Jazz Educator’s conference is pretty astounding actually, when you think of how far it’s come in the last few years.
Yeah, it’s gotten bigger and bigger. I just noticed the catalogue gets thicker.
